name: Surge Metrics
description: Medium and Large widgets for Surge iOS Prometheus metrics: cumulative traffic, memory, active requests, DNS cache, uptime, and interface traffic.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Surge iOS Prometheus 指标小组件：Medium 聚焦累计流量与核心状态，Large 展开网络接口流量。
localizedDescriptions.en: Medium and Large widgets for Surge iOS cumulative traffic, runtime metrics, and interface traffic.
